meta.title: Layout example: a definition and its explanation

blocks.text: This self-contained teaching example combines a definition with its condition and interpretation. It is not an excerpt from an uploaded source.

zh-CN.text: 这个自编教学示例把定义、条件和解释组合起来，并非上传原稿的节选。

blocks.html:
Weighted mean. For values and weights , divide the weighted sum of the values by the sum of the weights.

Condition. Here every weight satisfies , and . These conditions exclude division by zero and negative contributions.

Interpretation. Multiplying every weight by the same positive constant leaves the result unchanged. Only the weights relative to one another affect the mean.

zh-CN.html:
加权平均数。对于数值 及权重 ，用数值的加权和除以权重之和。

条件。这里每个权重满足 ，并且 。这些条件排除了除以零和负权重的贡献。

解释。将所有权重乘以同一个正常数，结果不变。决定平均数的是权重之间的相对关系。
